name: manual_6e70b1
claim: Reconcile dispatch packs by authoritative version and explicit operator GO; never execute a superseded HOLD pack after newer GO evidence arrives.

decisions.notes: Mac v4 plus the operator GO authorized Windows lanes 7-10 and superseded v1 through v3; running the older pack would have violated the current dispatch.

rationale: Mac v4 plus the operator GO authorized Windows lanes 7-10 and superseded v1 through v3; running the older pack would have violated the current dispatch.
